acceptanceCriteria: A test interleaves a retry start with run retirement and proves no run referenced by the live generation is removed.
The attempt-runner spec states the ordering guarantee.
body:
Found 2026-10-07 by the V1-0930/V1-0931 delivery lane (branch claude/cleanup-tasks, head 73a42cf2, based on batch 4 head 5808c26c) and retained by the orchestrator as a known limit of that delivery.

Suspected, from the lane's own analysis, not observed. Run retirement after a supervisor finishes (ATR-V0-015, proposed) is fenced by attempt generation but does not hold the store lock, so a retry that starts while retirement is scanning can lose earlier-generation run directories that the new generation would still cite.

Expected: retirement never removes a run that a live or newly started generation of the attempt can reference.
Actual (suspected): a narrow race window loses them.

title: Suspected: a retry racing detached-run retirement can remove earlier-generation runs of the same attempt
